txt: A wince. It's involuntary. "Bring that up *one more time* and you won't get to write that report."
Across, at the other table: hobnailed working boots, size 43. Gang tattoos. Mesque or Saramirizian. In his late thirties/early forties.
Alain -- who looks like he might be Titus' right hand man. The least antsy of the bunch; definitely not his first time being questioned by the police.
He blinks. "No, I didn't. Because I'm not fucking stupid, *polizonte*."
He does not. His unshaven face is almost grey, and he reeks of piss, sweat, and booze.
His eyes, which remain fixed on yours, become somewhat clearer, and he smiles a malevolent drunken smile. "Dennis is a dead man... just doesn't know it yet..."
Seeing you approach, the bruised man clenches his fists.
Seeing you approach, the bruised man raises his beer can in welcome.
Silence. He nods.
The dull eyes looking back to you from the narrow face momentarily light up and he mumbles: "What...?"
The eyes looking back at you from the narrow face are those of a dead man.
The eyes looking back to you from the narrow face momentarily light up and his lips move without sound.
The flicker of light in his eyes goes out and he collapses back on the table.
The man stares at you through the haze in his eyes.
The man stares at you with spite in his eyes.
The tattooed Mesque sinks into his seat, unsure how to respond. "Yeah... you should be."
The tattooed man scratches his head with his knuckles. "I don't remember, I was fuckin' drunk."
You've seen the expression on this one's face before, on a dozen hardened thieves and killers...
"*I'm* going to find Dennis," he interjects. "I'm going to find him and then I'm going to kill him."
"*Real* big dick cops... Look at them! Reckless, swinging in the wind."
"*This* is gonna make a hell of a sad tattoo..."
"... no worse than the bangers on Boogie Street."
"... will hunt you down and gut you like butcher..."
"...bullet's too good for me... Just let it end, *madre*..."
"Absolutely! Today I'm going to get drunk, eat good food, and bed a good-looking gal, 'cause tomorrow a motor carriage might run me over..."
"Ah, cut that shit out," the Mesque interjects angrily. "That's the kind of rhetoric bangers tell to kids in Jamrock to get them to join a gang. I'm sick and tired of this honour bullshit!"
"Ain't no one gonna be riding any ballads about me..."
"Ain't no one gonna be writing any ballads about me..."
"Alain is a fucking cockroach name... (unintelligible)... suits me..."
"Alain is a fucking roach name anyway... So *me*."
"Around the bullet, man..." Alain pinches the root of his nose. "That's a good one."
"At least he put the fucking fiddle down. I've seen this before, Titus. Addict cops. They got access to confiscated drugs and then they start *experimenting*."
"Avenge and die... that simple (hic)... You'll be proud, T..."
"Aye', cut that shit out, man."
"Been thinking of getting *Whirling-in-Rags* tatted on my ass, boss."
"Boogie street justice. Gonna make you proud, T."
"C'mere, you mesque coward... die with the rest... die like a man..."
"C'mon Glen, she likes Monica's titties more than *you* do." The Mesque smiles. "Everyone knows which way the wind blows there."
"Coppo loco." He looks at you and nods. "Good luck in Jamrock. Scars make the best tattoos, they say."
"Death ain't sad -- theirs was glorious. Hope mine will be dignified like that..."
"Don't worry, Titus, we know her. Besides, you know how it is with bitches and books."
"Don't worry, Titus, we know her. Besides, you know how it is with bitches and dances."
"For Titus... for Glenny... for... for Titus!!!"
"For Titus... for Glenny... for... for Titus... wait... already got one for Titus..."
"Fuck off, man."
"Fuck you! *I'm* not from around. That's not why we..."
"Fuck you, pig!" He stands. "What the fuck you playing at, huh?"
"Fuck, boss..." The tattooed man realizes something. "This is why he was always asking for the other guy's gun. He doesn't *have* his own."
"Fucking hell..." The tattooed man shakes his head. "Titus, did he just..."
"Get out of here, punk! Can't you see we're honouring our dead here."
"Gimme another one!"
"Gonna hunt that rat-faced fuck down."
"Good fucking luck, man... She knows this place like the back of her hand. You'll never find her."
"Good one."
"He lost his partner, the binoclard. Cops can't function without their butt-buddies."
"He's cobbling together shit so he can put her away. It's Cop 101."
"He's trying to woo us with cop science. Forensics shit. I've heard this mambo jambo."
"Hey, don't be going soft on me."
"Hey, hey... fuck you for ruining a beautiful idea!"
"I did what?! Can't remember shit, I was wasted."
"I don't know about that..." The tattooed man yawns and settles more comfortably on the bench. "I'm comfortable here... don't think any sliding would really help right now."
"I don't know, cop -- why don't you find your *lost gun* first?" The tattooed man bursts out laughing at his own joke.
"I don't. All I see is a cop who's about to kill himself -- again."
"I envy Theo. To go out in the twilight of your life in a blaze of glory..."
"I just..." He seems barely able to keep his head up. "...there's nothing left. NOTHING!"
"I kinda wanted to hear the circus, boss..."
"I think he's trying to find dirt on us, in our box. It's what they do, Shanks. Did you know policemen are sometimes called *pigs*?"
"I will not get weary... will not tire... hatred will carry me..."
"I'm the lucky fuck, who didn't take a scratch." (Sighs.)
"I've seen this shit a million times, Titus. Flyfishing -- they're desperate." He turns to you. "Tell us, copper, what wacky claims did he make?"
"If it's titties, then Monica's!"
"It does?"
"It's bound to happen again, you know." He taps on his right temple. "Just statistically speaking, of course."
"Let Dennis enjoy his fucking, man. We don't mind." You notice gang tattoos; the man must be either Mesque or Saramirizian.
"Like a fucking *cobarde*... bitchman-Alain, shit..."
"Listen, man. We told you we..."
"Look, copper." The tattooed man snaps his fingers to get your attention. "We know the dead fuck was a rapist and a killer. We got him confessing to it on tape."
"Marianne, *amigo*," he says pouring himself another drink.
"Must be something in the water in Jamrock," he says thoughtfully.
"My fucking elbow, copper." He looks you straight in the eye. "Samaran boxing-style."
"Nah, man. That's just Ruby. She's got shit under control," the man explains. "That's her whole thing. That's why she's so good."
"Next he's gonna kill himself -- again." The tattooed man looks at you with disdain.
"No -- but that doesn't prove anything."
"No fuckin' clue," the tattooed man shouts. "It's gotta be the crazy. Who'd *want* to be a pig?"
"No idea."
"No way I'm going back to Jamrock."
"Oh, don't even get me started on that Gareth Morrand crap!" The Mesque gets visibly agitated. "That racist fucking fuck... motherfucker."
"Oh, so you're just a simple, well-meaning man, huh?" He spits on the ground before him. "Ever been in solitary? Prison is *torture*, that's what it is."
"Or sent them to Reunion to *rot* -- for twenty years, for *life*?!" He says it as if it were worse than dying.
"Pigs, T -- they don't care about getting the truth, they care about getting convictions. They're fucking keeping score on their bulletin boards."
"Respectable professions don't shoot kids, *cerdo*!" He stands, hands wrapped tight around the back of his chair. "They don't beat confessions out of prisoners!"
"Right fucking here." He spreads his hands. "Eugene already told you that the fuck had started coming to *our* bar..."
"Right fucking here." He spreads his hands. "The fucker started coming to our bar. Asking for it."
"See boss, he's contradicting himself. Now he's saying it *wasn't* the roof. They can't put her there, it's all bullshit."
"See boss, they're contradicting themselves. Now they're saying it *wasn't* the roof. They can't put her there, it's all bullshit."
"Shame... (hic) burns worse than fire, man..."
"Shame... (hic)... burns worse than anything... I just want this to end...
"Shanky's gonna get a lesson in Boogie Street justice."
"She's just in denial, asshole. You don't understand the *traumatic experience*. She's shutting down. And she doesn't fucking trust you."
"Show it to him, T." He turns to Titus, who's still breathing heavily. "What's the harm, right?"
"Sons of bitches..." He mumbles something in Mesque. When he sinks down on the table again, a malevolent smile spreading across his face.
"Survivor guilt my ass, *I* wanted to go that way!"
"T... Ti... Tit..." The spit flying out of his mouth is accompanied by a painful grimace. "Tit... Titus's fuckin' dead..."
"Tell it like it's told, man. Tell it straight."
"That's just cop-tactics, Titus. Next he's gonna tell you one of us already rolled on the others -- and is in witness protection."
"That's sad, man -- but why are you squinting like that?" The tattooed man leans closer. "Looks to me like he's about to get aggressive."
"The Hardie boys are *unfuckable* now. We could take over the isola."
"The Hardie boys are *unfuckable* now."
"Then why the fuck was he asking you for *your* gun, huh? When he tried shooting himself or some shit... Because he doesn't *have* his own!"
"Theo went like he lived -- fast and hard. Tough old man."
"Think the mercs were bad? Should've seen the bangers down on Boogie Street..."
"Those flaccid MI cocks with their *culture* language." The Mesque spits on the ground angrily. "Everything's a *surreal play* or a *sublime whatever*. Doesn't mean anything."
"Uh... (unintelligible)... like a fucking *cobarde*... like a fucking bitch..."
"Uh... what?" He looks up, his eyes full of confusion, as if he'd just woken from a deep sleep.
"We could take over the entire city."
"We just missed one. Ruby doesn't know this place boss -- just these cops, diggin' up shit."
"Well, it's as they say -- you can't do anything with an *underdose*," the Mesque says with a philosophical look in his eyes.
"What are you, a fucking cop now, Angie? You want to be a Hardie -- or you want to be a cop?"
"What the fuck does the kitchen have to do with this?" The tattooed man does not understand.
"What winch? Where's the winch?"
"When it's done I'll just blow my brains out... Fuck everything."
"When it's done I'll just blow my brains out... I'll *earn* it..."
"Who are these people? To leave a fella hanging like that..."
"Yeah -- because they like to sniff around in *dirt*." The tattooed man gives you a look.
"Yeah and they don't put her on the roof either. It's just mambo jumbo. He hasn't got shit."
"Yeah like he's ever gonna pull top shelf pussy like that!" The tattooed man laughs. "He's what? Eight hundred years old now?"
"Yeah! It's like they put cowbells on you before they send you to the streets." He says provokingly. "What's with the cowbells, police man?"
"Yeah, 'cause I sorta *wanna* see that shit."
"Yeah, *I* knocked him out." The tattooed one speaks up, banging on his chest. "Came up behind him and clubbed him in the back of the head. He went down like a sack of sand."
"Yeah, a well oiled murder-machine!" He punches blondie on the shoulder.
"Yeah, go pay Monica a visit in Jamrock. She's got a knack for making men forget about their worries. Biggest pair of milkers in all of Revachol."
"Yeah, he was cobbling together shit. So he could put her away -- it's RCM 101."
"Yeah, man, you know..." He slaps his hand on the table in a sudden burst of drunk enthusiasm. "You know -- you've got this. You got this!"
"Yeah, some people have their shit together. What's wrong with that?"
"Yeah..." The man seems unsure of himself.
"Yeah..." There is a silence in the room. Alain starts saying something -- then thinks best not to.
"Yeah? Where are they now, huh?" He points South. "Sent back to Madre in an airtight cargo crate."
"You probably *did* though..."
"You're already signed up, *cerdo*." The man shakes his head. "This guy's seriously damaged, T."
